tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App page background behind all surfaces. Text on it: `text`, `text-strong`, `muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, popovers and inputs. Default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or nested ground: table header, hover row, segmented control track, code/mono chips. Text on it: `text`, `text-strong`, `muted`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, table row dividers. Never the only cue for a control (use `border-strong`).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox, radio and toggle outlines, the hairline around the filament bar on a thumbnail, and the 1px outline the page draws around a thumbnail's silhouette (`.pp-art`, from the picture's own alpha channel, so it is a token in both themes and nothing is baked into the image — 2.3 withdrew the server-baked `#6f7a96`). 3:1 or more on `surface`, `bg` and `surface-2` in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and table cells on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, money amounts, selected labels on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help text, captions, units, relative dates. 4.5:1 or more on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active nav, selected state, focus accent. Text or icon on `bg`/`surface`/`surface-2` at 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `primary` fills and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` or `primary-hover` fill. Dark in the dark theme, white in the light theme.

tokens.name: primary-tint-soft
tokens.usage: 8% primary wash: row hover, subtle highlight. Text on it: `text`.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: 14% primary wash: selected row/card, live-update flash. Text on it: `text`, `text-strong`, `primary`.

tokens.name: primary-tint-strong
tokens.usage: 20% primary wash: pressed ghost button, strong selection. Text on it: `text`, `text-strong`, `primary`.

tokens.name: paid
tokens.usage: Betaald: text and icon colour. Always paired with a check icon or the word. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `paid-tint`.

tokens.name: unpaid
tokens.usage: Open / Afgeschreven / destructive: text and icon colour. Always paired with an icon or the word. Never next to `paid` by hue alone. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `unpaid-tint`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Missing data (no spool, price or cost) and cautions. Paired with a warning icon. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `warning-tint`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices, Spoolman status, "voorgesteld" hints. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `info-tint`.

tokens.name: paid-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the Betaald badge and paid summary. Text on it: `paid`.

tokens.name: unpaid-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the Open badge, error alerts, danger confirmations. Text on it: `unpaid`.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of missing-data badges and warning alerts. Text on it: `warning`.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of info alerts and hints. Text on it: `info`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus-visible outline with 2px offset on every interactive element. 3:1 or more on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs, sheets and the mobile drawer.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton loader fill on `surface`.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (categorical). 3:1 or more on `surface`.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2: teal. Chosen away from the paid/unpaid/warning hues.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3: violet.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4: magenta. Keep apart from `unpaid` in the same chart.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5: slate, for "other".

tokens.name: viz-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, lowest. Fill only; the lowest two steps do not reach 3:1 on `surface`, so label values in text or outline the mark with `border-strong`.

tokens.name: viz-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, step 2. Fill only (see `viz-seq-1`).

tokens.name: viz-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, middle. 3:1 or more on `surface` from here up in dark; light reaches it at step 4.

tokens.name: viz-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, step 4.

tokens.name: viz-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential scale, highest.
